rows.label: tlk70000050_04_msg0001
rows.name:
If I hadn't happened to meet Adel-sama
that time, I'd be covered in Paras
right now.

rows.label: tlk70000050_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Bugs actually have a keen sense
of smell, and food matters
to both sides when lives are at stake.

rows.label: tlk70000050_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Anyway, I'm glad that's all over!
Now that the stress is gone, I'm
starting to get hungry.

rows.label: tlk70000050_04_msg0004
rows.name: Huh? It's still too early for a meal?

rows.label: tlk70000050_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Come on, I know! Of course I wouldn't
snack between meals. Ahahaha.
